question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
boundaries AS (
  SELECT 
    min_ms,
    max_ms,
    avg_ms,
    (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as short_boundary,
    (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as long_boundary
  FROM stats
),
track_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= b.short_boundary THEN 'short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= b.long_boundary THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN boundaries b
)
SELECT 
  category,
  ROUND(MIN(duration_minutes), 2) as min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(duration_minutes), 2) as max_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) as total_revenue
FROM track_classified tc
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
